description: This file defines the AsyncCommandClient interface, which provides asynchronous command-sending functionalities to devices within the Eclipse Hono client package. It includes method signatures for sending commands with various parameters, focusing on asynchronous communication and response handling.

classes.name: AsyncCommandClient
classes.description: An interface for sending asynchronous command messages to devices within the Hono platform, scoped per tenant and device. It extends MessageSender and provides methods for sending commands with different parameter sets, with the results delivered via Vert.x Future.

methods.name: sendAsyncCommand
methods.description: Sends an asynchronous command to a device with optional data, returning a Future that indicates success or failure. This method requires device ID, command name, data buffer, correlation ID, and reply ID.

methods.name: sendAsyncCommand
methods.description: Overloaded method that also includes content type and message properties, allowing more detailed command message configuration.
